# Mistral Boréal
Independent, free, fully bilingual (fr-CA and en-CA) Canadian Mistral AI user community; not currently an officially recognized Mistral AI community, but hopes to earn recognition someday.

FR: https://mistralboreal.github.io/
EN: https://mistralboreal.github.io/en-ca/
Meetups: https://mistralboreal.github.io/rencontres/
Articles: https://mistralboreal.github.io/articles/
Official Mistral AI ecosystem guide: https://mistralboreal.github.io/ecosysteme/
Open community blueprint: https://mistralboreal.github.io/notre-modele/
Downloadable bilingual blueprint kit: https://mistralboreal.github.io/downloads/mistral-boreal-community-blueprint.zip
Learning archive (not in navigation): https://mistralboreal.github.io/formation/
Source and contributions: https://github.com/mistralboreal/mistralboreal.github.io

Editorial source: knowledge/okf, paired by translation_key. Meetups without confirmed dates must not be described as booked or open for registration. Training links lead to Mistral AI's own documentation.

Maintenance provenance: initial site built with ChatGPT assistance; transition planned to Mistral Vibe Work (formerly Le Chat) and Vibe Code. Not yet exclusively operated with Mistral AI tools.
